description: Implementation of UserProfile interface for managing user profile data, including serialization to XML, and handling logger data selections and conversions within the RomRaider ECU tuning project.

classes.name: UserProfileImpl
classes.description: Class implementing user profile management, including XML serialization and profile data handling.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the logger data is contained in the profile.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Checks if logger data is selected on the dashboard tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Returns the selected data convertor for the logger data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the profile XML as a byte array.

methods.name: appendLoggerDataElements
methods.description: Appends logger data elements to the XML builder.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Retrieves the UserProfileItem for given logger data.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the appropriate map based on logger data type.
